run.mode: manual run: WebSearch in place of search_web, WebFetch in place of open_page
run.goal: a) Green-bean data for Coffea liberica and Coffea excelsa (C. liberica var. dewevrei): composition, size, density, origin or quality, row-level first. b) More green-bean Robusta (C. canephora) data with a species or variety column. c) If budget remains: the real row count of the May 2023 CQI update from a page that states it, and whether it repeats the Jan 2018 rows.
run.budget: 15 web steps (each search and each opened page = 1). Used 15 of 15.
run.verification_note: WebSearch returns an automatic summary of results and WebFetch returns an automatic summary of each page, so every page opened in this run is recorded as summary_only, never opened_and_read.
steps: 1 search: liberica / excelsa green bean datasets on Mendeley, Zenodo, figshare (goal a)
3 search: green bean datasets with arabica / robusta / liberica / excelsa labels (goals a, b)
4 open: data.mendeley.com/datasets/bgpd7mnnjn/1 (AS7265X reflectance, arabica and robusta)
6 search: liberica green bean caffeine, chlorogenic acid, trigonelline, sucrose (goal a)
7 open: ro.ecu.edu.au/ecuworkspost2013/6495 (liberica vs arabica, green and roasted)
8 search: Coffea canephora / conilon green bean datasets with clones or genotypes (goal b)
9 open: sbicafe.ufv.br item 7bfec290 (107 canephora genotypes) -> Access Denied by bot protection (Anubis)
11 search: robusta green bean datasets on Mendeley / Zenodo with variety or origin (goal b)
13 search: CQI May 2023 dataset row count (goal c)
14 search: 'CQI May 2023' Kaggle dataset rows (goal c)
15 open: repository.ipb.ac.id/handle/123456789/171080 (liberica green beans from Java, thesis)

dataset.title: Reflectance intensity dataset of green coffee beans (four origins) measured with AS7265X sensor
dataset.rows_note: Sample count not stated on the landing page; the Files section came back empty.
fields_seen: label (AF = Arabica Flores, AG = Arabica Gayo, RD = Robusta Dampit, RT = Robusta Temanggung)
reflectance intensity per channel, 18 bands from 410 to 940 nm, arbitrary units (column names not shown)
green_bean_measures: reflectance intensity, 18 spectral bands 410-940 nm (AS7265X sensor)
fluorescence: 12 further spectral datasets made by alternating violet and white LEDs (six visible wavelengths)
dataset.why_relevant: Green Arabica and Robusta beans from four named Indonesian origins, with a label that encodes species and origin, under CC BY 4.0. It answers goal b (Robusta with a species column), but the data are sensor readings only, with no chemistry, size or quality values, and the sample count is unknown.

paper_tables.paper_title: Profile of Bioactive Compounds, Aromas, and Cup Quality of Excelsa Coffee (Coffea liberica var. dewevrei) Prepared from Diverse Postharvest Processes
paper_tables.measures: Relative concentration (ug/kg beans) of 18 volatile compound classes in GREEN and roasted Excelsa coffee powder, against a 3-heptanone internal standard
paper_tables.coverage: 1 species/variety (C. liberica var. dewevrei, Wonosalam, East Java); 6 postharvest treatments (Natural 1, 2, 3, Wine, Honey, Semiwashed) per bean state; averages of 2 replications
paper_tables.note: Data Availability: "All data obtained or analyzed from this study are included in this published article." Licence: Creative Commons Attribution License (version not stated on the page).

paper_tables.paper_title: Profile of Bioactive Compounds, Aromas, and Cup Quality of Excelsa Coffee (Coffea liberica var. dewevrei) Prepared from Diverse Postharvest Processes
paper_tables.measures: Individual volatile compounds and their classes in green and roasted beans (59 compounds in 12 classes for green beans, 85 in 18 classes for roasted, as stated on the page)
paper_tables.coverage: 1 species/variety; same 6 treatments as Table 1 (per-treatment layout not seen)
paper_tables.note: Supplementary file listed on the page; not downloaded.

paper_tables.paper_title: Profile of Bioactive Compounds, Aromas, and Cup Quality of Excelsa Coffee (Coffea liberica var. dewevrei) Prepared from Diverse Postharvest Processes
paper_tables.measures: Cupping scores (mean +/- SD) for 10 attributes plus total score, measured on the roasted brew
paper_tables.coverage: 1 species/variety; 6 samples (same treatments as Table 1); 3 replications
paper_tables.note: The search summary says the paper reports green-bean caffeoylquinic acids and alkaloids by processing method, but the page summary listed no table for them (Table 2 is aroma descriptors for roasted beans). Where those values sit was not verified.

paper_tables.paper_title: Comparison of liberica and arabica coffee: Chlorogenic acid, caffeine, total phenolic and DPPH radical scavenging activity
paper_tables.table_number: unknown (the landing page lists no tables; the full-text PDF was not opened)
paper_tables.measures: Chlorogenic acid, caffeine, total phenolics and DPPH radical scavenging in green and roasted C. liberica and C. arabica, plus C. liberica at several roast levels
paper_tables.coverage: 2 species; number of samples not stated; bean origin not stated
paper_tables.note: Asian Journal of Agriculture and Biology 7(1) 130-136, 2019. "This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 License."

opened_not_registered.title: NIRS intact green coffee beans with CGA content, species and Geographical origins from Java, Indonesia
opened_not_registered.reason: Licence (CC BY 4.0) and access ('Download All', .txt and .unsb files) are shown, but there is no file list, no field names, no sample count, and the species are not named, so rule (b) is not met. NIR spectra 1000-2500 nm of intact green beans from Java, and the title says it has CGA content, species and origin. If the species include robusta or liberica it fits goals a or b, but that is not confirmed.

opened_not_registered.title: Karakteristik Fisikokimia, Metabolit Sekunder, dan Aktivitas Antioksidan Biji Kopi Liberika (Coffea liberica) dari Pulau Jawa
opened_not_registered.reason: Undergraduate final assignment (IPB University, 2025) on green Liberica beans from Java: bean dimensions, colour, proximate content, total phenols, flavonoids, antioxidant activity (DPPH, CUPRAC, FRAP), compared by location. Not a dataset. The full text and appendix (Lampiran) are flagged isAllowed=n, so table numbers and sample counts are unknown. Only 'All rights reserved' in the site footer; no item licence.

goal_c_cqi_may_2023.note: No page in this run states the row count of the May 2023 update. The only figure seen is 1,509 cupping records, from a citing paper (run 1, not accepted here). A search summary says the Baselight listing text mentions data from January 2018, which would suggest an overlap, but that is search_result_only and the mirror has shut down. The Kaggle page returned only its title in run 1, so it was not retried.

done_for_now.summary: 15 of 15 steps used. Registered 1 dataset: Mendeley AS7265X reflectance of green Arabica and Robusta beans from four Indonesian origins (CC BY 4.0, rows unknown). No row-level liberica or excelsa dataset was found. Liberica / excelsa data exist only as paper tables (Excelsa postharvest paper on PMC; Mubarak et al. liberica vs arabica) and in an IPB thesis with restricted full text. Three pages were blocked (Roboflow 403, SBICafe bot protection, preprints.org 403). The CQI May 2023 row count is still unverified.
